# input: # A cell beginning with = + @ - is a FORMULA in Excel/LibreOffice/Sheets, so
# collected text can run code on the ANALYST machine. Expect a leading '.
# NO COLUMN MAY BE EMPTY: bash read collapses consecutive TABs. Write "-".

note: the classic DDE payload, as a file name
at-sign, used by Lotus-style syntax Excel still honours
minus followed by text is a formula, not a number
a negative NUMBER must be left alone - quoting it would corrupt real data
and so must a negative decimal
a timestamp starts with a digit, untouched
